description: A `prompt_type: array` prompt with a scripted JSON-array reply (`["a", "b", 3]`), spliced two ways: a `json` tool's `params_json` via `{{{prime.items.value}}}` lands the real native JSON list in `meta.params_rendered.input`; an ordinary `template:` splicing the same value now renders the same JSON text in `meta.prompt_sent` too (circuitry#778 step 3 -- formerly Python's own `str()`, repr-ish and single-quoted, the asymmetry quirk Q2 used to document). `params-json` only ever splices a string from `json stringify`, never a native list.
